For even \(n=2k\):
\[
a_{2k+2}=a_{2k}+2,\quad a_2=2
\]
so
\[
a_{2k}=2k.
\]
Thus the even-indexed terms sum:
\[
2+4+\cdots+100=2(1+2+\cdots+50)=2550.
\]

For odd \(n=2k-1\):
\[
a_{2k+1}=-a_{2k-1},
\]
so the 50 odd-indexed terms alternate \(a_1,-a_1,a_1,\ldots\), summing to \(0\).

Therefore,
\[
S_{100}=2550+0=2550.
\]

\[
\boxed{2550}
\]
